_comment: Shared test vectors of the insights engine (Muster): the app's computeInsights
(backend/app/domain/insights.py) must give exactly these results. The file lives in core
(backend/tests/fixtures/insights/vectors.json) and is copied into the app's tests; change both together.
Every tracked_at is written as PostgREST sends it: the user's WALL CLOCK in the UTC slot (+00:00), so
23:30+00:00 is 23:30 local. Each side reads it as local wall clock in `timezone` (Dart: wallClockFromWire,
run under TZ=Europe/Vienna; Python: the fields with tzinfo=timezone, never astimezone). `now` is a real
instant (the device clock) with its offset. The 24 h meal window is 24 real hours (Dart's local
DateTime.subtract), so across a DST switch it starts at another wall-clock hour. Days are local dates in
`timezone`. Input lists are in the order the engine receives them. `calendar.classes` lists the days that

vectors.description: No entries: 30 days without a class, nothing unlocked, nothing yet.
6 active days and 3 gut-feeling entries: still locked. The journey lists the active days.
7 active days and 3 gut-feeling entries: unlocked.
7 active days but only 2 gut-feeling entries: still locked.
The window runs from local midnight 29 days ago (25 Oct, a 25-hour day) through the end of today; entries a minute before it or at tomorrow's midnight do not count, a later-today one does.
tracked_at is the wall clock: a 23:30 entry stays on its date and a 00:15 one on its own, read at 23:45.
Summer time (CEST): a 22:15 entry stays on its date, also with its meal window; one at 22:15 on the day before the window (15 Jun) does not count, one at 00:15 on its first day does.
A mean of exactly 2.5 is good, just above is medium (5/2, 10/4, 7/3, 8/3, 15/6, 18/7).
A mean of exactly 3.5 is medium, just above is hard (7/2, 14/4, 10/3, 11/3, 21/6, 25/7).
An entry counts with its worst gut symptom; the mood never counts; a mean of 1.5 (and 5/3) is good; a 1 and a 5 make a medium day.

10 Nov: a 3 at 08:00, then a 5 at 12:00 (mean 4): the anchor is 12:00, the first schlecht entry. The meal window [anchor - 24 h, anchor) includes a meal exactly 24 h before and excludes one at the anchor.
15 Nov: a 4 at 08:00, 1 at 12:00, 1 at 14:00 (mean 2, good): the anchor is 12:00, so a meal at 13:00 does not count. Entries are given out of order.
A hard day on the window's first day (25 Oct, 07:00 CET): its meals reach into 24 Oct (CEST), 21:00 inside, 06:00 outside.
24 h before 25 Oct 12:00 CET is 24 Oct 13:00 CEST, not 12:00: a meal at 13:00 counts, one at 12:59 does not.

Spring: 24 h before 29 Mar 12:00 CEST is 28 Mar 11:00 CET, not 12:00. The window (12 Mar to 10 Apr) steps calendar days across the 23-hour day (23:30 on 31 Mar is that day; its meal window holds no meal).
At 18:00 a hard entry logged for 21:00 counts, its window ends at 21:00 (a meal at 19:00 is in, 21:30 out); entries from tomorrow's midnight are ignored.

Names match trimmed and case-insensitively, once per meal and day; blank names are skipped. The shown spelling is the most recent meal's (by time, not position; the first listed on equal times), also outside every window, never one after today.

H = 5, G = 6. Zwiebel rate 0.8 gap 0.633, Knoblauch 0.6/0.433, Brot 0.6/0.267 are shown; Kaffee (gap 0.1) and Milch (rate 0.4) are not. Columns: oft dabei on at least 2 days and at least half of them.
H = 4, G = 2: Apfel on 2 hard days (rate 0.5, gap 0.5) is noch unsicher; Birne's gap is 0. An uncertain item is never the pick, and the good-days column (2 days) is not shown.
H = 6, G = 12: Reis 4/6 - 5/12 is a gap of exactly 0.25 (as doubles 0.2499...), Hafer a rate of exactly 0.5; both count. Dinkel (rate 1/3) does not.
Sorted by hard, then the gap, then the name without case: Dill (4, 0.8), Senf (4, 0.4), Zimt (3, 0.6), apfel (3, 0.4), Birne (3, 0.4).
Ties sort in German order (DIN 5007-1): Ä as A, Ö as O, ü as u, ß as ss; equal folds (Masse, Maße) by code unit. Only the top 5 of a column are kept.
At most 5 shown items, then at most 3 noch unsicher ones.
oft dabei: at least 2 days and at least half of them (Hafer 2 of 4 yes, 2 of 5 no). Nothing stands out (Reis' gap is negative), so the good days are the pick.
2 good and 2 hard days: neither column is shown, so they list nothing, and there is no Fällt mir auf.
A meal at 20:00 on 9 Nov is in the window of 9 Nov (21:00) and of 10 Nov (19:00).
The journey: the active days, oldest first, each marking whether it had a Bauchgefühl.
9 active days: the journey holds only the latest 7; a Bauchgefühl on an earlier day is not on it.
